subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should the public meeting-runtime `permissions` callback permanently require the requested meeting URL now, or should the SDK introduce an explicitly versioned/deprecated compatibility path for external meeting plugins?
rationale: The branch changes a documented Plugin SDK contract used by platform adapters; repository policy requires maintainer-visible direction for plugin API additions or behavioral changes even when bundled callers are migrated.

options.title: Approve the URL-aware callback
options.body: Accept the new URL-aware permission input as the canonical Plugin SDK contract, with the updated documentation and baseline serving as the public migration point.

options.title: Add a transition contract
options.body: Keep a documented compatibility/deprecation path for existing external adapter implementations before making the URL input mandatory.

recommendation.title: Approve the URL-aware callback
recommendation.body: Accept the new URL-aware permission input as the canonical Plugin SDK contract, with the updated documentation and baseline serving as the public migration point.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the Teams adapter and carried the shared meeting-browser follow-up, so they are the strongest available routing candidate for the API decision.
